text:
maria: quick async standup — microburst + KV snapshot
what I did: landed microburst scheduler tweak in kernel v2, ran a perf sweep on p3-small, ~8% P99 improvement for seq=512.
blockers: KV snapshot test flakes on canary; hitting intermittent KV.EVICT_TOO_BIG during concurrent warmups.
today: triage the KV snapshot race, add backoff for prefetch, coordinate a canary after patch and ask QA for quick run. :mag:

alex: saw the same on canary this morning. repro steps I used:
1) canary with --parallel-warmups=8
2) flood 5k requests seq=512 (small payloads)
log snippet: 
```
E KV: Evict size 1.2GB > limit 1.0GB
runtime/kernel/kv.go:412
```
seems like eviction threshold calc doesn't account for microburst batch multiplier.

tj: adding @ryan for kernel/kv numbers. quick thought — lower default concurrent warmups to 4 for canary until we sort this to avoid thrash.

ryan: ACK. I'll push a hotfix to the eviction calculation: change to use max(mem_limit*0.85, static_limit) and add better accounting for batch multipliers. will also add DEBUG logging for slice sizes. ETA ~2h.

sara: pinging QA — can you run the scheduled canary after ryan's patch? @qa-bot

qa-bot: scheduled canary run "microburst-kv-snapshot" at 2026-03-17T12:45Z. I will post results and a quick diff of key metrics (P50/P95/P99, eviction events). :robot_face:

maria: thanks — also noticed batching heuristics improved throughput ~6% in synthetic runs but tokenizer variance at seq=128 caused a small regression in token alignment tests. filing follow-up PR to pin tokenizer to v1.4.1 for canary.

alex: saw the PR, left a tiny nit on the docstring. otherwise looks good.

tj: one more ops-level ask: can we add a roll-forward fallback route in routing policy so requests hit q4_0_small when observed tail > 350ms? would reduce app-level error budgets during canary spikes.

maria: good idea, I'll add a fallback policy to the rollout config and enable it for the canary group. will also add a metric alert for fallback rate > 1% so we catch regressions early.

ryan: pushed the eviction calc patch to ryan/kv-evict-hotfix, CI running. I'll drop a note when canary image published.

sara: QA will validate once image is up. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria: nice progress. follow-ups: (1) ryan — merge hotfix + publish canary image, (2) me — update rollout config + tokenizer PR, (3) alex/tj — quick PR review if available.

alex: will try to review in next hour.

tj: same.

qa-bot: canary run queued. will post crash/evict counts and latency table once done.

maria: closing this thread — i'll post CANARY results and next steps when available. :sparkles:
